context: Patch _project/decisions/github-org-transfer-benchbox-dev-2026-08-21.md and docs/operations/github-org-transfer.md (and the transfer pointer in repo-admin-settings.md if it still says org-verify before G4). Record live evidence: apex A/AAAA are GitHub Pages IPs; www.benchbox.dev CNAME is joeharris76.github.io; user challenge TXT exists; org challenge TXT is absent. Sequence: optional org TXT add (no Verify) -> transfer -> confirm 200 on apex and www -> update www CNAME to BenchBox-dev.github.io if needed -> org-verify -> only then remove user verification. Cite GitHub docs: verified domains are account-exclusive; verifying a domain in use elsewhere immediately releases it; already-verified domains refuse a second verification.
description: The landed 2026-08-21 decision and docs/operations/github-org-transfer.md put org-level GitHub Pages verification of benchbox.dev in G0, before transfer. GitHub Pages domain verification is exclusive: verifying on BenchBox-dev while the site is still published from joeharris76/BenchBox would either fail (domain already verified by the user) or immediately unbind the live site. Amend the decision record and transfer runbook so G0 may add the org challenge TXT only, must keep user verification and apex DNS unchanged, and org Verify plus www CNAME retarget happen after G4 once https://benchbox.dev/ is still 200. This is in-repo docs only. Do not transfer, do not click org Verify, do not change live DNS A/AAAA records.

anti_patterns.dont: Change apex A/AAAA records or delete the joeharris76 challenge TXT before transfer
anti_patterns.instead: Keep current serving DNS; the apex already points at GitHub Pages IPs
anti_patterns.why: Those records are what keep https://benchbox.dev/ working today

anti_patterns.dont: Click Verify for benchbox.dev on org BenchBox-dev while the repo is still user-owned
anti_patterns.instead: Leave user-account Pages verification in place until after G4 and a live 200
anti_patterns.why: GitHub Pages domain verification is exclusive; a successful org verify immediately releases other accounts' Pages bindings

anti_patterns.dont: Point www.benchbox.dev at BenchBox-dev.github.io before the repo lives in the org
anti_patterns.instead: Retarget www only after G4 if www 200 fails or as a planned post-transfer DNS step
anti_patterns.why: The org has no Pages site until the repo is transferred

preserves.behavior: JoinOrder manifest URL and answers default URL unchanged
